3682-3698-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-3698-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mox Amber, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4452-4779-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-4779-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

225-2577-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2577-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

240-728-5470-7730.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3017-5742-5743-7824.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2043-4742-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-4742-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

3562-4050-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Sky Hussar token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sky Hussar, adding at least one mana.
Repeat.

1003-3558-5860-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3558-5860-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

101-364-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
101-364-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-364-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1263-2921-4871-4976.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-2292-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

101-2104-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

112-3075-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
112-3075-7426.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Mizzix of the Izmagnus, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-4321-5256-6277.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5256-6277.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2440-4758-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Eldrazi and Spawn you control.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2440-4758-5685.notes: You should only perform step 3 if you have no {G} available. The initial mana cost can be reduced if you control additional Eldrazi and/or Spawns.

240-1879-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

225-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
225-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G} or the land card in hand can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5702--143.description:
Earthbend a land, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

1315-3293-5478-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1315-3293-5478-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1315-3293-5478-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2510-2921-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2510-2921-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2510-2921-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

186-1887-2060-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-1887-2060-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1636-3143-5455-5696.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5455-5696.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

3693-3818-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Sengir has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Sengir deathtouch.
3693-3818-4613.description:
Give Sengir deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Sengir using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls, and killing it due to Sengir's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Sengir's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
3693-3818-4613.notes: If you have a way to give Sengir deathtouch indefinitely, you can repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

225-654-2893-4500.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-654-2893-4500.description:
Activate a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the basic land enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Kazandu  trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-1817-3756.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1817-3756.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

1914-2034-2500-3169-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar five times by sacrificing the Myr tokens, adding ten {C}.
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, targeting Myr Battlesphere.
Cowardice triggers, returning Myr Battlepshere from the battlefield to your hand.
Mirage Mirror's ability fails to resolve  due to no longer having a legal target.
Repeat.

1946-2904.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Nomads en-Kor ability.
Repeat.

539-4241-5175.notablePrerequisites:
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
Caged Sun does not have summoning sickness.
539-4241-5175.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Caged Sun to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Caged Sun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat step 2.
As Caged Sun's triggered ability is a mana ability, this combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that cannot be interacted with, thus ending the game in a draw.
